purpose: Distinguish acceptable primitive universe constants from forbidden target-fit knobs in the no-knob program.
allowed_only_if: has a source role in theory definition, topology, flux, action normalization, branch selection, or coherence tolerance
not removable by unit convention or quotient
constrains more observables than the one used to identify it
forbidden: choosing thresholds to match observed gauge couplings
candidate_primitive_classes: finite branch data such as N and q64
coherence/admissibility data such as epsilon_adm and C_Q
action-unit data such as alpha_int, G10_int, and string-length normalization
a single shared dimensionless internal normalization

rho_uv_policy.preferred: prove R internally from the Selected Horizontal-Scale Lemma
rho_uv_policy.acceptable_fallback: R may be primitive only if it is universal, prior, audited, and used across sectors
rho_uv_policy.forbidden: R selected after comparing rho_UV or electroweak data
